note: BUG#40 (QualityControl ledger) — an entity-level command wiped its parent aggregate's own `projects`-declared field to null. `rust/src/generated/banking/registry.rs`'s entity-command dispatch arms (`Banking::Account.LedgerEntry.Reverse`/`...Amend`) hardcoded `owner_deref: Vec::new()` and only ever pushed the whole hydrated parent record onto `command_deref` under the key "parent" (for `parent.customer_status`-style given/ensures lookups). `dispatch_entity_ledgerentry_reverse` then called `seeded_projections(&with_references, ACCOUNT_PROJECTED_FIELDS)`, and `ACCOUNT_PROJECTED_FIELDS` declares `ProjectedFieldSpec { field: "customer_status", reference: "customer", remote_field: "status" }` — `seeded_projections` looks up the deref keyed literally "customer" (`reference_lookup.rs#seeded_projections`), present in NEITHER the empty `owner_deref` nor `command_deref` (only "parent" and the entity's own args live there), so it always resolved `None`. `dispatch_entity` (`dispatch.rs`) unconditionally applies every `seed_projections` entry via `set_projected_field` on EVERY entity-command save, so every entity-level command on any `projects`-declaring aggregate overwrote that field with null, even when correctly seeded moments earlier. Confirmed genuinely broken before this fixture existed: after step 4 below, Ruby's `Account#acct1.customer_status` stays "active" (correctly seeded at Open, preserved through Credit); unmodified Rust's same record regressed to null. Fixed by having the entity-command codegen's `owner_deref` carry the PARENT aggregate's own already-known reference fields — the same `owner_deref` an aggregate-level `Act` command already builds via `crate::kernel::owner_deref`, dereferenced off `parent_id` instead of `id` — rather than leaving it hardcoded empty.
